name: Murray State University
tuition_note: In-state (KY resident) undergraduate tuition & fees for 2026-27 ($5,265/semester flat rate plus mandatory fees = $10,530) from murraystate.edu Bursar's Office Undergraduate Tuition page. Housing is room only (no board): $6,252/year for cheapest standard double (Regents/White Hall, $3,126/semester) from Fall 2026/Spring 2027 Housing Rates page (murraystate.edu/campus/Housing/housingrates.aspx).
